localizedValues.name: Camp Wooten
localizedValues.description:
Please check availability online. To make a reservation, please obtain a reservation request form at https://parks.wa.gov/find-activities/retreat-centers and email it to Retreat.Centers@parks.wa.gov
Camp Wooten Retreat Center can sleep up to 150 people in cabins. Facility may be able to accommodate additional overnight guests in tents and RVs/trailers (no hookups) with program staff approval. The retreat center comes with a heated indoor swimming pool. The pool is operational mid-April to mid-October. The large lodge has a fully equipped kitchen and dining hall. Pots, pans, dishes, utensils, and cleaning supplies are provided. Bring your own bedding, pillows, and towels as linens are not provided.
